angle: From what a person already knows. I began with seven situations an educated reader recognises without the theory (a target pushed while something uncounted wears down; a standard used because everyone uses it; a ranking refit to its own clicks; an auditor paid by the audited; a habit that outlasts its reason; a warning in time or too late; the people who would have objected having left), marked the places such a person would put on a map, then checked each against all 88 items (59 exits, 23 transitions, 6 compose) of the 24 dynamics. Kept from the person's list: used-because-it-is-used, the uncounted being used up, nothing outside counting, those who'd notice gone, someone with a say seeing it, past turning back. Added because the data has them and my list missed them: the pair "it pays, so it spreads / it costs, so it fades" (12 arrow rows sit on that one threshold), "not yet settled" and "all on the same one" (the code dynamics and drift), "the left-out now counts" as distinct from merely being seen (the theory's own separated-but-not-responded), and "ended". Dropped from the person's list: "the judges are the winners" as its own place (the data treats it as the mechanism of used-because-used, not a separate condition); "auditor paid by the audited" has no dynamic of its own (who pays whom is not modelled) and survives only as the example of a reading-only place. Read only; nothing in the repository was changed; no tests or builds run.

coverage: In scope: 24 dynamics (scope.json lists 23 ids, not 24; plus what-an-optimum-does-beyond-what-couples-in). Items: 59 exits + 23 transitions + 6 compose = 88. Assigned: 67 items as arrows (69 arrow rows, because reading-a-loss-in-time transition 1 and the-lock-draws-its-readers-out transition 1 each fork into two arrows); 8 items as laws of staying (held_by: capture-by-counted-choices transition 1; readings-revised exits 1, 3, 6 and compose 1; unselected-beyond exits 9, 10, 11); 13 unresolved. 67 + 8 + 13 = 88. Arrow rows by how far seen: exact 25, sufficient 15, witness 17, necessary 2, a bound 1, reading 6, argued 2, open 1. Five dynamics have no item at all and appear only in held_by: target-capture, a-reading-against-the-share-does-not-ratchet, capture-reaching-the-routes-of-correction, selection-for-narrowing-what-couples-in, self-reproducing-selection-across-carriers. Not counted: two compose entries that arrive at offspring-read-from-giving-that-waits from outside the scope (what-a-rise-draws-from-beyond, what-decides-giving-against-keeping-on-a-flow). Places: 14 (11 with laws, 1 law-on-named-model pair counted in those, 1 a reading, 1 open).
what_the_layer_shows:
1. The chain's spine is a nesting, not a path. 'Used because it is used' contains 'nothing outside it counts', which contains 'those who'd notice are gone': each is the one before plus one more thing made from who is ahead (the rule; its interpreters; who is present to notice). The data never gives an arrow for how a rule comes to be remade from its own results; that is always a premise. The only inward arrows are two pace bounds (given the premise, held within two remakes) and readings.

2. The arrows cluster at thresholds. 12 of 69 rows sit on the single pair pays/costs; 7 are 'flips' of used-because-used onto its other side; 7 run between not-settled and all-on-one. The region is rich in 'which side' and 'when', thin in 'how one gets in' and 'what happens after'.

3. Three places have no way out in the data: 'the left-out now counts' (nothing says what follows a turned rule; the one hint, that it can become a hold of its own, is a reading with no exit), 'past turning back' (no item joins it to 'ended', though a worked case shows the ending one step later), and 'ended'. 'The uncounted gets used up' has no way in: nothing says how something comes to be pushed that hard.

4. The two lanes barely join by law. One lane is about the rule and who is in it; the other about what the rule leaves out. That the uncounted thing grows inside the loop is supplied (it grows by one a step), not derived from the law that a best outcome uses up what it does not count. That the drain is what removes the watchers is a reading (two rows), argued (one) and one worked case. So the sentence a person most wants from this region, 'pushing the target wears away the people who would have objected, and then nothing can stop it', is drawn here with dashed lines.

5. The centre of the concern is the one open arrow. pays/costs is nearly an island: twelve rows between its two sides, one worked case in (the cost falling on those ahead), and one arrow marked open, from 'those who'd notice are gone' to 'it pays': removing the watchers being itself what pays the rule-makers. The entry says the join is not made. That is the hole to draw as a hole.

6. Two places have no arrows at all: 'the checkers follow the winners' (a reading) and 'changes hands, stays the same' (open). They should be drawn as empty outlines beside the region.

7. Seeing is not counting. 'Someone with a say sees' and 'the left-out now counts' are different places, and two argued items say why one can stay in the first: several pushers each ranking by their own, and everyone else drawing faster than it renews. How a loss comes to be seen inside the loop is also always supplied (a given step N); only the exchange laws say when someone can first tell.

8. Five of the six compose entries in scope carry no joint law; the two that are proved are identifications ('the same place in two models'), not movements. The layer needs that third mark beside arrows and laws of staying.

9. A person's situations that the data does not hold: an auditor paid by the audited (who pays whom is not modelled; it survives only as the example of a reading); and a rule that leans against whoever is ahead (one law says the ratchet does not form; no exit or transition, so it is a law of staying in 'not yet settled' and no place of its own).
layout:
A ring layout read west to east as rough time, with no vertical ranking.

Centre: three nested outlines. Outer: used-because-used. Middle: nothing-outside-counts. Inner: those-who'd-notice-are-gone. Nesting says what the data says: each is the one outside it plus one more thing made from who is ahead. The seven 'flip' arrows are drawn as one small loop on the outer ring labelled 'pushed across the tipping point: held the other way', so both sides of a hold are visibly one place.

West: not-yet-settled, with its two arrows east into the outer and middle rings.

North: all-on-the-same-one, above the rings and slightly west, so its seven arrows to and from not-yet-settled run along the north-west without touching the rings, and the three arrows up from the rings (two by chance, one from the inner ring) are short.

North-east: pays and costs as a see-saw of two small nodes joined by one thick double arrow (eleven exact thresholds, listed beside it) and one single arrow. One arrow reaches costs from the outer ring; the open arrow from the inner ring to pays is drawn dashed and labelled 'not made'.

South lane, west to east under the rings: the-uncounted-gets-used-up (south-west), someone-with-a-say-sees (south), the-left-out-now-counts (east, level with the rings so the three arrows out of the middle ring and the one out of the outer ring reach it without crossing). Arrows up from the-uncounted into the inner ring are dashed (readings), with one solid for the worked case. Arrows between the inner ring and someone-with-a-say-sees are vertical and short.

South-east: past-turning-back, reached from someone-with-a-say-sees directly east and from the-uncounted by an arc under the lane; ended at the far south-east edge, reached by an arc along the bottom. Leave a visible gap, with no arrow, between past-turning-back and ended, and none leaving the-left-out-now-counts.

Outside the rings to the far north-east, two empty dashed outlines with no arrows: the-checkers-follow-the-winners and changes-hands-stays-the-same.

Why this has no good-top, bad-bottom reading: the top holds all-on-the-same-one and both sides of pays/costs; the bottom lane holds both the-left-out-now-counts and ended; the east edge holds both as well. Crossings: the only arrows that must cross a ring boundary are those entering or leaving the nested places, which is the point of drawing them nested. Line style carries how far seen: solid for exact, sufficient and necessary, thin for witness, dashed for reading and argued, dotted for open.
doubts:
Where I am least sure, and what I would argue against in my own proposal.

1. One place for both sides of a hold. I made 'used because it is used' a single place and drew seven items as flips onto its other side. That fits 'a language, a habit, a currency and a monopoly are the same loop', but self-arrows are unusual on a map and a merger may prefer two places or to file the flips as laws about the tipping point.

2. pays/costs named for any costly practice, not for rule-making. The data's pair is about the capacity to change the rule; I generalised because a proved compose puts answering-in-kind on the same threshold. A reader looking for 'control over the rule being rewarded' finds it only in the gloss and example. Offspring transition 3 (mixed pairs) is not covered by the compose, which assumes like-with-like pairing; I placed it on the pair by the general name alone.

3. 'The left-out now counts' receives two different things: a rule turned by a judge who counts the loss, and a floor that only limits how far the uncounted may be taken (what-an-optimum exit 1, where the pusher still takes everything down to the floor). In the judges' models 'turned for good' is literally 'held the other way', so this place may be 'used because it is used' again with one more thing counted.

4. 'Past turning back' joins two senses (a thing that can no longer be kept; a hold no objection of the same kind turns) on the strength of a reading. If that reading is not accepted it is two places.

5. Where an exit leaves from. The atlas's exits leave a dynamic by dropping a premise; a place is narrower or wider than a dynamic. Several from-places are my judgment: shaping-read-by-readers exit 1 and the-lock-draws exit 2 from 'someone with a say sees' rather than from the hold; the selection-read-off exits from 'those who'd notice are gone' although some describe designs under which the watchers would never have gone.

6. how_far. I read base 'World' as 'law on any process'. It is the theory's general setting of exchanges, not a named model, but it is narrower than 'any type'; I said so in the place where it matters. Several main laws are called near-definitional by their own entries; the four-value scale has no room for that.

7. Left out to stay at 14: 'still going' (the pair of 'ended'; persisting-filters' main law lives there and its exit 1 is unresolved for want of it), 'the judges are the winners', and 'the rule leans against whoever is ahead'. Any of the three could fairly be a place.

8. 'Ended' is coarse: it holds a bystander ending and everyone ending. The data distinguishes them only in worked cases.

9. Some conditions lean on the entry's wording, not on the Lean. I confirmed law names against the entries' declaration lists but did not open the Lean statements; DrawnReplacement.fixation and Drawn.through_locks I did not use because I had not read what they state.

10. The Chinese labels are my ear, not Ren's, and '赢家' and 'winners' may still read as taking a side. The word 'loss' is avoided in labels but the data uses it throughout; 'what is used up' is my substitute and is slightly narrower.
